tracePolicy: Every parent requirement, invariant, and success criterion maps to at least one fixture case or matrix region; every fixture case carries at least one trace.

traces.requirement: Dialog stack hosting and focus restoration discipline: A0 stack, LIFO pop, caps, history locking, one modal root.
New/lesson/import replacement confirmation; confirm rides the serialized stop-and-swap; cancel is inert; failures preserve the authoritative state.
Startup recovery Keep/Discard with fallback: all five A1 dispositions have designed accessible UI.
traces.parentSource: U5 required implementation and success criteria

traces.requirement: Canonical/legacy import file/paste preview with grouped report; no auto-apply; commit via confirmation; chart text insert-only.
JSON/text export success/failure surfaces with browser-handoff honesty.
Dirty/export/recovery markers remain truthful; only exact export success advances the canonical marker.
Storage unavailable/quota/corrupt states are visible, actionable, and never block editing or export.
Recovery is never called Save; the status strip speaks only the frozen vocabulary.
Oversized history-boundary disclosure; Undo unavailability is never hidden.
Dialog stack/focus restoration: exact trigger, workflow target, workspace; cancel/failure/success symmetry; selection preserved.
traces.parentSource: U5 required implementation and test plan
